message.content:
The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see the current screen is the Internet settings page in the Settings app. I can see there's a Wi-Fi toggle switch that appears to be currently off (the toggle is on the right side and appears to be in the off position based on the description).

Looking at the screen, I can see:
- Internet section at the top
- T-Mobile (Mobile data won't auto-connect)
- Wi-Fi toggle switch (appears to be off)
- AndroidWifi (Saved / No internet access)
- Network preferences
- Saved networks
- Non-carrier data usage

To turn WiFi on, I need to tap on the Wi-Fi toggle switch. The toggle appears to be located at coordinates around [846, 377] based on the layout.

Let me tap on the Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on.
do(action="Tap", element=[846,377])
